name: agent-desktop
tagline: Vercel Labs CLI that gives any coding agent computer use on macOS, Windows and Linux by reading the OS accessibility tree instead of guessing from pixels

xSignals.text: Introducing agent-desktop: agent-browser, for your whole computer. Computer Use for any coding agent on macOS, Windows and Linux; runs in the background while you keep working; agents use your computer in parallel, each with its own cursor.
